html:
Sun control window film helps to reduce heat and glare from entering your home. Below find out more about our solar control window film and why it is such a great choice for Australian homes.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. All our films are exclusive to us and are supplied by the largest supplier of window film in the world.

All installations are done by professionally trained installers and we offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications of sun control film for home windows (up to 15 years for commercial applications). Here is how solar control window film works

How Solar Control Window Film Works

How solar control window film works is that is made up of particles that absorb and reflect the sun’s heat & glare. This helps to keep your home cooler and also reduces reflections on screens in your home. Depending on the type of solar control window film you choose, here are some of the other benefits of having sun control film for home windows installed.

  • Protection against harmful UV rays (our films are government certified by ARPANSA)
  • Reduction in fading of your flooring and furnishings
  • A warmer home during winter months (which you’ll notice in your power bills)
  • Privacy (stop those on the outside from seeing in your home during the day whilst still letting natural light in – no more blinds, shutters or curtains pulled during the day!)

If you want to enjoy the benefits of sun control film for home windows but are worried about how it may look, we have the film available in lighter shades that don’t alter the appearance of your home.
